# ToteMove
> Reusable plastic moving tote rental for Brampton, Mississauga, Caledon, Georgetown, and surrounding areas in the GTA and Halton Hills. Delivery and pickup included. Flat-rate pricing by home size.

ToteMove is a local moving supplies rental service based in Brampton, Ontario. It rents industrial-strength plastic totes, delivers them before your move, and picks them up after. Every package includes a heavy-duty dolly and a 14-day rental window.
